# rixl_subtitle (Resource)

Uploads and manages subtitles (VTT or SRT) for a Rixl video.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rixl_subtitle" "english" {
  project_id    = var.rixl_project_id
  video_id      = rixl_video.keynote.id
  language_code = "en"
  label         = "English Subtitles"
  file_path     = "/path/to/subtitles_en.vtt"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_path` (String)
- `label` (String)
- `language_code` (String)
- `project_id` (String)
- `video_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `format` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `vtt_path` (String)
